title: Req2Rust: A Requirements-Guided Agent Harness for Project-Level C++-to-Rust Migration
title_zh: Req2Rust：用于项目级C++到Rust迁移的需求引导智能体工具框架

paragraphs.en: Req2Rust是首个项目级C++到Rust迁移的LLM智能体框架，显著提升测试通过率。 Memory-safety concerns make Rust an attractive target for modernizing legacy C/C++ systems, yet project-level C++ migration must balance semantic fidelity with Rust-oriented reconstruction. Source-structure-preserving migration can track low-level behavior, but it can also carry source-language organization, unsafe idioms, and project assumptions into Rust. Direct agent-based translation gives the model more freedom to construct a Rust project, but semantic coverage depends on the model identifying the source behaviors that must be preserved. This problem is especially acute for C++, where source behaviors are often hidden in object models, destructor-driven lifetime protocols, and other hard-to-localize C++ semantics. This paper presents Req2Rust, the first project-level LLM-based C++-to-Rust migration harness. Req2Rust first derives an evidence-grounded Migration Requirements Specification (MRS) that records the behaviors and constraints that must be preserved. It then synthesizes a Rust Design Specification (RDS) and realizes it as an initial Rust project. Because real projects contain implementation details and idioms that only become visible during build and validation, Req2Rust treats the initial Rust project as an executable refinement state. Compiler, semantic, and unsafe-reduction validators produce validation reports for improving buildability, behavioral alignment, and unsafe usage. We evaluate Req2Rust on general C++ projects and modules from the large-scale Openharmony codebase against a ClaudeCode baseline. Req2Rust produces buildable Rust crates in both settings and improves test pass rate from 69.5% to 91.9% on general projects and from 45.4% to 87.9% on Openharmony modules.
paragraphs.zh: Req2Rust是首个面向项目级C++到Rust迁移的LLM智能体框架，显著提升了测试通过率。出于内存安全性的考虑，Rust成为现代化改造遗留C/C++系统的一个有吸引力的目标，然而项目级的C++迁移必须在语义保真度与面向Rust的重构之间取得平衡。 保留源码结构的迁移方式可以追踪底层行为，但也可能把源语言的组织方式、不安全惯用法以及项目假设带入Rust。 基于智能体的直接翻译给予模型更大的自由度来构建Rust项目，但语义覆盖率取决于模型能否识别出必须保留的源代码行为。 这一问题对C++尤为突出，因为C++的源代码行为往往隐藏在对象模型、由析构函数驱动的生命周期协议以及其他难以定位的C++语义之中。 本文提出了Req2Rust，这是首个基于LLM的项目级C++到Rust迁移工具框架。 Req2Rust首先推导出一个以证据为依据的迁移需求规约（MRS），记录必须保留的行为和约束。 随后，它合成一个Rust设计规约（RDS），并将其实现为初始的Rust项目。 由于真实项目包含只有在构建和验证过程中才能显现的实现细节和惯用法，Req2Rust将初始Rust项目视为一个可执行的细化状态。 编译器校验器、语义校验器和不安全代码缩减校验器生成验证报告，用于改善可构建性、行为一致性和不安全代码的使用。 我们在通用C++项目以及来自大规模Openharmony代码库的模块上，以ClaudeCode作为基线对Req2Rust进行了评估。 Req2Rust在两种场景下都能生成可构建的Rust crate，并将测试通过率在通用项目上从69.5%提升至91.9%，在Openharmony模块上从45.4%提升至87.9%。
